name: Bidirectional Differentiable Path Tracing
aliases: Temporal histogram estimation via bidirectional path tracing
definition: An algorithm to estimate the rendered temporal histogram and its scene derivative for a specific pixel by combining camera and light subpaths (bidirectional path tracing) and connecting them via time-gated ellipsoidal sampling.
summary: Bidirectional Differentiable Path Tracing estimates temporal histograms and scene derivatives by combining camera and light subpaths via time-gated ellipsoidal sampling to improve efficiency in transient imaging.
